structural-causal.name: crossDivisionLeverage
structural-causal.basis: Processing, connectivity, security and power functions combine across automotive and industrial edge systems.

structural-causal.name: substitutionResilience
structural-causal.basis: Embedded qualification can create persistence, but competing MCUs/processors/connectivity and customer-designed silicon remain substitutes.

structural-causal.name: supplyChainResilience
structural-causal.basis: Diversified raw-material sourcing helps, while just-in-time inputs and semiconductor manufacturing remain interruption-sensitive.

discovery-weak-signals.name: physical-AI exposure
discovery-weak-signals.basis: NXP's processing, connectivity and security portfolio is positioned across vehicles, factories and robots where edge intelligence is expanding.

discovery-weak-signals.name: data-center adjacency
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Management now identifies Data Center as an additional growth engine, broadening beyond traditional automotive/industrial exposure.

expectations-execution.name: operating execution
expectations-execution.basis: Broad revenue growth and strong free cash flow provide current operating evidence rather than roadmap-only claims.

expectations-execution.name: expectation bar

items.risk: Management attribution of growth drivers is directional evidence, not proof that each theme will sustain current growth rates.
